Reference

Course glossary

Shared vocabulary for the BA Lending Academy. Regulatory meanings track the GTM glossary and the India regulatory register.

AA
Account Aggregator — RBI-licensed consent-based rail for sharing a customer's financial information with the lender.
Aadhaar
India's biometric identity number. Biometrics, OTP and PID artefacts must never be stored by the platform.
Amortisation
The schedule by which each instalment splits into interest (on the outstanding balance) and principal.
APR
Annual Percentage Rate — the all-inclusive cost of the loan expressed as a rate, disclosed in the KFS.
Audit hash chain
Per-tenant, append-only SHA-256 chain sealing every state change; tamper-evident and verifiable.
CAM
Credit Assessment Memo — the underwriter's structured case note supporting a credit decision.
CERSAI
Central registry for security interests (SARFAESI); secured lending registers and satisfies charges here.
CERT-In
India's computer emergency response team; qualifying cyber incidents must be reported within 6 hours.
CIC
Credit Information Company (credit bureau) — receives fortnightly loan performance data in the UCRF format.
CIMS
RBI's Centralised Information Management System — the reporting channel for DLAs and statutory returns.
CKYC
Central KYC registry (CKYCRR) — reusable KYC records searched, downloaded and uploaded by REs.
Co-lending
Arrangement where regulated entities jointly fund a loan: shares sum to 100%, an originating-RE retention floor applies, the borrower sees one blended rate, funds move through escrow.
Compliance OS
The control plane: regulatory catalog, policy registry, DLA/LSP registries, consent ledger, model governance.
Conditions precedent
Conditions that must be satisfied (or formally waived) before disbursement; open ones block funds.
Cooling-off period
Board-approved window after a digital loan is disbursed during which the borrower may exit by paying principal and proportionate charges.
Decision engine
Per-tenant, fail-closed, byte-replayable Rust engine that evaluates lending policy and AI guardrails and enforces the kill switch.
Digital worker
A governed, proposal-only AI agent installed per tenant with pinned model, prompt, knowledge and action scope.
DLA
Digital Lending App/website (RE- or LSP-owned); reportable to the RBI in CIMS-ready form.
DLD 2025
Reserve Bank of India (Digital Lending) Directions, 2025 — the current source of truth for digital lending conduct.
DLG
Default Loss Guarantee — capped loss cover (5% of the portfolio) from an eligible LSP, with a 120-day invocation window.
DPD
Days Past Due — how many days the oldest unpaid amount has been overdue; drives buckets and classification.
DPDP
Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023 — consent, notice, access, correction and erasure duties for personal data.
DRT
Debts Recovery Tribunal — adjudicates larger secured-recovery actions.
DSA
Direct Selling Agent — a sourcing channel whose conduct and payouts the RE must govern.
EMI
Equated Monthly Instalment — the level payment that amortises principal and interest over the tenor.
Escrow
A neutral account through which co-lending funds must flow — no single-partner pass-through.
Evidence pack
Integrity-attested export of a tenant's audit evidence for an authorised request.
FIU-IND
Financial Intelligence Unit – India; receives STR/CTR/CCR filings through the FINnet gateway.
FOIR
Fixed Obligation to Income Ratio — share of income already committed to EMIs; a core affordability test.
Foreclosure
Early full repayment that closes the loan before the scheduled end of tenor.
FPC
Fair Practices Code — conduct rules for lenders, including recovery contact-hours limits enforced in collections.
Grievance officer
Named officer accountable for complaint resolution inside the RBI's 30-day window.
GST
Goods and Services Tax — applies to fees and charges; must be disclosed and accounted correctly.
IRACP
RBI's Income Recognition, Asset Classification and Provisioning norms — the rulebook behind SMA/NPA treatment.
KFS
Key Facts Statement — mandatory pre-contract disclosure of APR, fees, penal charges, cooling-off and grievance path.
Kill switch
Control that instantly blocks a model (model-scoped or global); affected decisions degrade to human review, fail closed.
LMS
Loan Management System — the live loan account: ledger, repayment, servicing, collections, closure.
LoanOS India
India-only, multi-tenant SaaS lending operating system for RBI-regulated entities.
Lok Adalat
Statutory conciliation forum used to settle smaller recovery disputes.
LOS
Loan Origination System — customer onboarding through sanction and disbursement readiness.
LSP
Lending Service Provider — a partner acting for the RE; must stay inside the RE's accountability boundary.
LWS
Loan Workflow System — routes human and operational work: maker-checker, exceptions, grievance, fraud.
Maker-checker
Four-eyes control: the person who prepares an action cannot be the person who approves it.
MITC
Most Important Terms and Conditions — borrower-facing summary of contract terms.
Moratorium
A sanctioned pause in repayment (full or interest-only) at the start of, or during, a loan.
NACH
National Automated Clearing House — mandate-based auto-debit rail commonly used for EMI collection.
NOC
No Objection / no-dues certificate issued to the borrower at closure.
NPA
Non-Performing Asset — an account overdue beyond 90 days; triggers income-recognition reversal and provisioning.
OTS
One-Time Settlement — accepting less than full dues to close an account, under a policy and authority matrix.
PAN
Permanent Account Number — the tax identifier verified during KYC.
Penal charges
Charges for contract breach. RBI requires them to be reasonable, disclosed upfront and never capitalised — penal interest is prohibited.
Policy bundle
Content-hashed, four-eyes-approved, signed package of lending and guardrail policy that the decision engine evaluates.
PTP
Promise to Pay — a dated repayment commitment captured during collections, tracked as kept or broken.
RBI
Reserve Bank of India — the banking regulator; issues the directions this course keeps citing.
RBI CMS
RBI's Complaint Management System — where unresolved borrower complaints escalate to the Ombudsman.
RE
Regulated Entity — bank, small finance bank, payments bank, co-operative bank, NBFC, HFC or All-India Financial Institution accountable to the RBI.
Restructuring
Changing sanctioned terms (tenor, rate, schedule) for a borrower in difficulty; carries classification consequences.
Sanction letter
The lender's formal offer recording approved amount, terms and conditions, with a validity window.
Sandbox
Evaluation environment enforcing synthetic-only borrowers and mock integrations.
SARFAESI
Act letting secured lenders enforce collateral (60-day demand notice, possession, sale) without a court decree.
Section 138
Negotiable Instruments Act provision criminalising cheque dishonour; a common recovery lever.
SMA
Special Mention Account — pre-NPA stress signal: SMA-0 (1–30 days), SMA-1 (31–60), SMA-2 (61–90).
STR
Suspicious Transaction Report filed with FIU-IND when AML monitoring finds reportable behaviour.
Tenant
One contracting regulated entity; all of its data lives inside a hard-isolated boundary.
UCRF
Uniform Credit Reporting Format — the consumer/commercial/MFI reporting annex under the 2025 CIC directions.
UPI AutoPay
UPI-based recurring debit mandate; an alternative EMI collection rail.
V-CIP
Video-based Customer Identification Process; recordings and logs must be stored in India.
Write-off
Removing dues from the earning book (often 'technical' write-off) while retaining the legal right to recover.

LoanOS India · BA Lending Academy

Educational content, not legal advice. Regulatory statements summarise the control families in the India regulatory register and must be verified with compliance and counsel before reliance. A capability citation reflects catalogue status, not production readiness.
